set.body:
Point 4. Reuses the Story and recall split-screen mapping issue; removes its chronology prerequisite. AT-06/07/08/11/13 are acceptance references, not extra tickets. Provider projection semantics arrive through the local adoption gate.

Boundaries: AppView, VoyageView, ViewChoice/shared state, semantic navigation, minimal MatrixView/Intaglio lowering, exact DOM reading/evidence rails. Source and recall must open together.

Acceptance:
1. One artifact-qualified Address selection/focus survives source, matrix and Voyage projections, resize and semantic zoom. Keep OnMark/ViaAncestor/OffProjection explicit; selecting a hidden child does not turn it into its parent. Source and recall cursors/horizons remain independent; no clock or order is inferred from another.
2. Canonical ordinal keyboard traversal reaches every supplied recall unit, including untimed, onset-only, failed and all-external units. Audio navigation is a distinct optional mode. Browser focus survives updates and stale responses cannot activate against another artifact.
3. The minimal matrix displays ONE producer-declared fixed target cut with exact labels, supplied measure semantics/scale and complete per-unit accounting. All supplied alternatives are inspectable. External numeric values differ visibly from failures, abstentions and unresolved processing; hidden supplied remainder differs from unknown omitted candidates. No source-only renormalization, imputed cells or invented hierarchy aggregation.
4. Selecting a row/cell exposes exact permitted source and recall support, decision origin, missingness, term support and unavailable calibration. Source selection finds every associated recall through the provider query. Repeated references and discontinuous evidence remain intact. An accessible table/DOM control uses the same handlers; shape/text complements color.
5. Presentation controls only alter projection/layout. A scientific-policy control selects a separately supplied checked mapping artifact, with compatibility/refusal supplied upstream. Missing reference output stays unavailable; historical/reconstruction output is never relabeled reference. No browser estimator run.

Falsifiers: restore timed-only filtering; key selection by ordinal/renderer ID; drop an external/failed row; renormalize after hiding a column; substitute a hull or only the best alternative; apply an old request to a newly loaded source. Independent fixture expectations must fail for each relevant mutation.

Evidence: exact producer/consumer/Intaglio/grakern revisions, actual overrides distinguished from declared pins; compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS; existing shell smoke plus named M1 workflow tests. Preserve warnings as findings and make changed code warning-clean. Browser automation uses the project browser, ownership audits before/after, and closes owned processes. Add a discriminating failure injection for each new boundary. Preserve static no-JavaScript publication as a separate contract. Test names for new M1 courts are specifications until implemented; never claim them run from ticket creation.
set.title: [M1] Share selection, matrix and exact source-recall evidence
